Name: SegEarth-R1
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.09644. Introduces the remote-sensing pixel-reasoning task and an LLM-guided model that parses implicit instructions, reasons over spatial context, and outputs target-region masks; releases the EarthReason dataset (5,434 annotated image masks, 30k+ implicit QA pairs). Code, dataset and checkpoints are released; checkpoints on HuggingFace org earth-insights (SegEarth-R1-EarthReason and SegEarth-R1-RRSIS-D variants), dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/earth-insights/EarthReason. A second checkpoint (SegEarth-R1-RRSIS-D) is mirrored at modelscope.cn/models/earth-insights/SegEarth-R1-RRSIS-D.

Name: SegEarth-R2
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20013. Targets pixel-level grounding of detailed text in remote-sensing imagery; introduces the LaSeRS benchmark for complex-instruction segmentation and SegEarth-R2 with spatial attention supervision and a flexible segmentation query mechanism. Code released 2026-05-24 and LaSeRS dataset on HuggingFace (https://huggingface.co/datasets/earth-insights/LaSeRS); code only, no public weights as of 2026-08.

Name: Delta-LLaVA
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14044. Addresses 'temporal blindness' of MLLMs in remote-sensing change understanding; introduces the Delta-QA dataset (180k visual QA samples) and Delta-LLaVA with Change-Enhanced Attention, Change-SEG, Change Prior Embedding and Local Causal Attention. Paper states code and dataset 'will be open-sourced' but no official repo, weights, or dataset page found as of 2026-08 (github.com/mzamini92/Delta-LLaVA is an unrelated different paper, not this work).
Error: code/weights not yet released as of 2026-08

Name: EarthVL
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02783. Proposes EarthVL, a progressive staged framework for Earth vision-language understanding/generation (EarthVLNet) that couples land-cover semantics with object-aware relational reasoning, together with the EarthVLSet benchmark (10.9k high-resolution images, 761.5k QA/caption text pairs). Companion dataset EarthVLSet is released on HuggingFace (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kingdrone-Junjue/EarthVLSet), but the official repo (https://github.com/Junjue-Wang/EarthVL) is a placeholder ('We are preparing the code and data') and no model weights are public as of 2026-08.
Error: code/weights not yet released as of 2026-08

Name: GeoChrono
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.15768. Introduces a benchmark for long-term temporal understanding in remote sensing (change tracking, historical memory, spatio-temporal reasoning) and GeoChrono with specialized temporal modeling and token compression, supported by an instruction-tuning dataset. Weights on HuggingFace and ModelScope; ChronoBench/ChronoInstruct data released as GeoChrono-Data on both platforms (https://huggingface.co/datasets/Davidup1/GeoChrono-Data); benchmark images sourced from DVL-Suite.

Name: TerraScope
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19039. Presents a unified pixel-grounded vision-language framework for Earth observation that grounds answers in masks, handles optical/SAR inputs separately or jointly, and analyzes temporal changes; releases Terra-CoT (1M samples) and TerraScope-Bench. Model weights at https://huggingface.co/sy1998/TerraScope; datasets TerraScope-Bench and TerraCoT on HuggingFace (sy1998); code in the TerraScope folder of the Earth-Observation-VLMs repo. Published at CVPR 2026 (batch venue 'arXiv' corrected); project page https://shuyansy.github.io/terrascope/.

Name: Geo-R1
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21976. Proposes reasoning-centric reinforcement fine-tuning for few-shot geospatial referring expression understanding (FS-REC, FS-GRES, FS-OVD), where the model first generates explicit reasoning then localizes objects, improving generalization and cross-dataset robustness over SFT baselines. Multiple checkpoints released on HuggingFace org Geo-R1 (Geo-R1-3B/7B-GRPO variants for REC/GRES/OVD at 1/5/10 shots); code and processed datasets in repo.

Name: GeoVLM-R1
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25026. Proposes reinforcement fine-tuning with Earth-observation-tailored rewards to improve remote-sensing reasoning, reporting gains over general and domain-specific VLMs. Project page: https://mustansarfiaz.github.io/GeoVLM-R1/. Official toolkit repo (https://github.com/mustansarfiaz/GeoVLM-R1-Toolkit) is a placeholder (README/setup only; training and finetuning code 'coming soon') and no weights found on HuggingFace as of 2026-08.
Error: code/weights not yet released as of 2026-08

Name: GeoZero
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22645. Proposes GeoZero, an MLLM for geospatial reasoning without any predefined CoT supervision, using GeoZero-Instruct for warm-up SFT, GeoZero-Hard to encourage harder reasoning during RL, and Answer-Anchored GRPO (A2GRPO) to keep diverse outputs accurate. Weights on HuggingFace (hjvsl/GeoZero, e.g. GeoZero-8B-without-RFT) with Baidu NetDisk mirror; training/eval datasets released as hjvsl/GeoZero_Train_Datasets and hjvsl/GeoZero_Eval_Datasets on HuggingFace.

Name: RemoteReasoner
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.19280 (accepted at AAAI 2026). Unifying geospatial reasoning workflow: an MLLM trained with reinforcement learning understands prompts and locates targets, transforming outputs to object-, region-, and pixel-level tasks without specialized decoders or tuning, with SOTA results and robustness on unseen tasks/OOD categories. Weights (Qwen2.5-VL-based) on HuggingFace (1e12Leon/RemoteReasoner, open access); training uses the EarthReason dataset (earth-insights/EarthReason). A duplicate author upload exists at modelscope.cn/models/ShengxiangXu/RemoteReasoner.

Name: TinyRS-R1
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12099. Presents TinyRS and its reasoning-enhanced version TinyRS-R1, compact (~2B, Qwen2-VL-2B-based) remote-sensing multimodal models built via satellite-image pretraining, visual instruction tuning, reasoning-based fine-tuning and GRPO alignment, matching or beating larger 7B RS models with lower memory/latency. Weights on HuggingFace (aybora/Qwen2-VL-TinyRS-R1; also Qwen2-VL-TinyRS, -CoT, -PRETRAIN variants); code, models and dataset captions released.

Name: Geo-R
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.00388 (accepted at AAAI 2026 per repo README). Geo-R: retrieval-free vision-language reasoning for image geolocalization using Chain of Region interpretable supervision from known coordinates and coordinate-aligned RL rewards based on Haversine distance. Code released on GitHub (aialt/geo-r); code only, no public model weights as of 2026-08 (paper states model and code 'will be made publicly available'). Note: Download_Link2 (HF The-Shy/Geo-R) hosts SFT training data (MP16-Rand-500k zip + geocoded prompt JSONs), not model weights.

Name: GeoReason
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04118. Shows RS-VLMs can give correct answers via faulty reasoning or positional shortcuts, and proposes GeoReason to align thinking and answering using GeoReason-Bench (4,000 reasoning trajectories), Supervised Knowledge Initialization and Consistency-Aware RL with a Logical Consistency Reward and option permutation strategy. Model weights at https://huggingface.co/WenshuaiLi/GeoReason (ungated, apache-2.0) and benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/WenshuaiLi/GeoReason-Bench.

Name: GeoSolver
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09551. Scales test-time reasoning for remote sensing with fine-grained process supervision: builds the Geo-PRM-2M step-level corpus, trains the GeoPRM process reward model, and applies Process-Aware Tree-GRPO to obtain GeoSolver-9B (GLM-4V-based) with test-time scaling. Weights hosted on HuggingFace (minglanga/GeoSolver, open access); the Geo-PRM-2M dataset was not found on HuggingFace as of 2026-08.
Error: arXiv page 'Code' link is a placeholder (https://github.com/yourname/GeoSolver); the actual official repo is https://github.com/minglangL/GeoSolver

Name: GeoVista
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14475. Visually grounded active perception for ultra-high-resolution remote sensing: broad-then-local observe-plan-track workflow that inspects candidate regions and tracks discovered clues, plus a supervised reasoning corpus and reward-based training. Weights on HuggingFace (GeoVista-7B-Instruct and GeoVista-7B-Preview), both gated (auto-approve, requires agreeing to terms on HF, hence Needs_Application=Yes); companion dataset APEX-GRO (ryan6073/APEX-GRO) also gated. Project page: https://ryan6073.github.io/GeoVista/.

Name: GeoX
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20006 (Ahn, Lee, Gummadi, Cha). Self-play framework for geospatial reasoning: a single multimodal policy creates and answers image-grounded spatial tasks as executable programs via abduction, deduction, and induction, with a verifier providing rewards for RL; reports gains up to 5.5 points and promises a benchmark. No official code, weights, or benchmark found as of 2026-08 (note: HuggingFace 'U4R/GeoX' belongs to a different GeoX paper, arXiv 2412.11863, on geometric problem solving).
Error: code/weights not yet released as of 2026-08

Name: RemoteAgent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07765 (repo states accepted at IEEE TGRS 2026). RL-based agentic MLLM bridging vague human intents and Earth observation: uses the VagueEO corpus and reinforcement fine-tuning so the MLLM internally handles image- and sparse-region-level tasks while invoking specialized tools via Model Context Protocol mainly for dense predictions. Code only, no public weights as of 2026-08 (no HF model; VagueEO dataset not found on HuggingFace). ModelScope repo AIMGroup/RemoteAgent exists in search but contains no public files as of 2026-08.

Name: RemoteZero
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04451. Label-free geospatial reasoning with zero human annotations: converts proposed regions into crops, uses semantic agreement with the query as reward signal, and trains via DAPO/self-evolution RL with earlier models checking later outputs. Official code released (GitHub, includes verifier server and DAPO/SelfEvolution training scripts); code only, no public weights as of 2026-08.

Name: RS-EoT
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22396 (CVPR 2026, Shao et al., 'Asking like Socrates: Socrates helps VLMs understand remote sensing images'). Identifies 'pseudo reasoning' and the 'Glance Effect' in remote sensing VLMs, then introduces RS-EoT and SocraticAgent with a two-stage progressive RL strategy that seeks visual evidence via Socratic questioning, improving RS question answering and grounding. Model RS-EoT-7B (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-based) on HuggingFace (ShaoRun/RS-EoT-7B, open access); companion dataset RS-EoT-4K released as HF dataset ShaoRun/RS-EoT-4K; official repo GeoX-Lab/Asking_like_Socrates.

Name: RS-HyRe-R1
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17504. Addresses 'perceptual inertia' induced by RL tuning in remote sensing VLMs with a hybrid reward mechanism encouraging broader spatial reasoning, accurate perception, and less repetitive evidence building; reports strong results on REC, OVD, and VQA with zero-shot generalization. Weights (Qwen2.5-VL-based) on HuggingFace (geozgz/RS-HyRe-R1, open access); pre-processed datasets provided in the GitHub repo.

Name: RSThinker
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22221 (ICLR 2026, OpenReview id lJ7zecny2e). Proposes Geo-CoT, a perceptually-grounded geospatial chain-of-thought for remote sensing VLMs; trains with SFT and GRPO on the Geo-CoT380k corpus so RSThinker outputs answers with verifiable analytical traces. Weights (GLM-4V-based) hosted on HuggingFace (minglanga/RSThinker, open access); companion dataset Geo-CoT380k released as HF dataset minglanga/GeoCoT380k.

Name: Earth AI
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.18318. Presents Earth AI, a Gemini-powered geospatial agent that combines specialized Earth-data foundation models (global imagery, population, environmental signals) with a cross-modal reasoning layer and an agent that coordinates models, large datasets, and external tools for multi-part, crisis-response questions. Closed-source system; no public GitHub repository or model weights were found (related project page: https://x.company/projects/bellwether/).
Error: No public code or model weights released; closed-source.

Name: EarthAgent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17198. Proposes designing domain-specific agents via a Hierarchical Task Abstraction Mechanism (HTAM), implemented as EarthAgent for remote sensing, and introduces the GeoPlan-bench planning benchmark with metrics for tool selection, workflow comparison, and logical completeness. No model weights (training-free agent). Agent code is marked 'Coming soon' and not yet released; the GeoPlan-bench benchmark platform is available at https://github.com/earth-insights/GeoPlan-bench. Project page: https://earth-insights.github.io/EarthAgent.
Error: EarthAgent code not yet released (Coming soon); no public weights.

Name: VRA
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16343. The Visual Reasoning Agent (VRA) is a training-free, inference-time scaling system that combines off-the-shelf LVLMs with a large reasoning model through iterative Think-Critique-Act cycles for multi-model checking and recursive refinement, improving remote-sensing VQA (up to 40.67% gains; 52.8% to 78.8% with three LVLMs on VRSBench VQA). No model weights; no public GitHub repository or code was found.
Error: No public code or model weights found.

Name: Earth-Agent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23141 (OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=dkIXAbWuxO). Earth-Agent is an agent framework for Earth observation that handles both standard imagery and spectral measurements, invokes specialized tools/models, and performs multi-stage scientific analysis. Code only, no public model weights. Companion benchmark Earth-Bench (248 tasks, 13,729 images, dual-level reasoning/result scoring) is hosted on HuggingFace.

Name: GeoMMAgent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08896. GeoMMAgent is a training-free, multi-agent 'plan-execute-evaluate' framework for expert-level multimodal QA in geoscience and remote sensing, paired with the GeoMMBench benchmark (1,053 image-linked MCQs). Code only for the agent (no trained agent weights); auxiliary tool weights (YOLO11 classification/OBB checkpoints) and the GeoMMBench dataset are on HuggingFace (shihaocheng/GeoMMAgent, AR-X/GeoMMBench). CVPR 2026 Highlight.

Name: MAP-Agent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12237. From the UHR-Micro paper; MAP-Agent (Micro-evidence Active Perception) turns questions into evidence-search steps, examines candidate regions, and answers using localized observations to address tiny-object perception in ultra-high-resolution remote sensing. No model weights. Companion benchmark UHR-Micro (11,253 instructions, 1,212 UHR images). Official GitHub repo exists but is an empty placeholder with no code or weights yet.
Error: GitHub repository (MiliLab/UHR-Micro) is an empty placeholder; code/weights not yet released.

Name: OpenEarthAgent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17665. OpenEarthAgent is a tool-augmented geospatial agent (Qwen3-4B based, 'OpenEarthAgent-4B') trained on satellite images, text requests, and explicit reasoning-step traces; it consolidates image, spectral, GIS, and raster tools into a shared callable catalog (14,538 training / 1,169 eval cases, 107,000+ steps). Model weights (apache-2.0) on HuggingFace at MBZUAI/OpenEarthAgent; companion dataset also on HuggingFace.

Name: PMMC
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00962. PMMC (Prospective Multimodal Memory Compilation) moves reasoning from question time to memory formation for long-term LVLM agents: a Questioner forecasts likely questions, a Planner prepares question-specific multimodal memory programs, and a Doubter verifies evidence paths, compiling approved pairs into a query bank for fast routing. No model weights; no public code released (paper is very recent, Aug 2026).
Error: No public code or model weights found (paper very recent, Aug 2026).

Name: TerraAgent
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13148. TerraAgent is a ReAct-style executable agent framework that interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and observations to connect LLM planning with tools for Earth-data retrieval, geospatial processing, simulation, and artifact-supported computation. Code only, no public model weights (repo keeps datasets, keys, and weights out). Companion benchmark TerraBench (403 agent tasks across 3 tracks and 8 domains, 24,500 validated execution steps).

Name: PriorCLIP
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1145/3581783.3612587 (ACM MM 2023; extended version: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.10160). Proposes PriorCLIP for remote sensing image-text retrieval, using visual priors (Spatial-PAE and Temporal-PAE) for unbiased representation learning and adaptive vision-language alignment against semantic noise and domain shifts, with staged open-setting learning and a cluster-based symmetric contrastive attribution loss; benchmarked on RSICD and RSITMD. Checkpoints provided via Baidu NetDisk link in the official repo (extraction code 2v3v).

Name: GeoRSCLIP
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2024.3449154 (arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.11300). Builds RS5M, a 5-million-image remote sensing image-text dataset filtered from public paired data and captioned label-only RS datasets, and trains GeoRSCLIP by adapting CLIP through a domain pre-trained vision-language model, improving zero-shot classification, cross-modal text-image retrieval and semantic localization. Weights (RS5M_ViT-B-32.pt, RS5M_ViT-H-14.pt, plus GeoRSCLIP-FT for retrieval) at HF Zilun/GeoRSCLIP. Companion RS5M dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/omlab/RS5M and Baidu NetDisk links in repo.

Name: RemoteCLIP
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2024.3390838 (arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.11029; the batch's arXiv id 2306.09282 is incorrect). RemoteCLIP is a vision-language foundation model for remote sensing trained with contrastive learning; pretrained checkpoints for ResNet-50, ViT-B/32, and ViT-L/14 are hosted on HuggingFace (chendelong/RemoteCLIP), with the training dataset at huggingface.co/datasets/gzqy1026/RemoteCLIP. A personal third-party re-upload of all three official checkpoints exists at modelscope.cn/models/wokaikaixinxin/RemoteCLIP (not author-maintained).

Name: SatCLIP
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17179. SatCLIP learns global, general-purpose geographic location embeddings by contrastively aligning satellite image features with coordinates, enabling downstream geographic prediction tasks with improved cross-location generalization (Microsoft Research; also published at AAAI 2025). Six pretrained checkpoints on HuggingFace under microsoft/: SatCLIP-ResNet18-L10/L40, SatCLIP-ResNet50-L10/L40, SatCLIP-ViT16-L10/L40. Microsoft also mirrors ResNet18/ResNet50 variants (L10/L40) on ModelScope.

Name: DGTRS-CLIP
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.19311. Introduces DGTRSD, a dual-granularity remote sensing image-text dataset pairing each image with both a brief caption and a longer description, and DGTRS-CLIP, a CLIP-based vision-language foundation model trained on both caption scales; reported gains on retrieval, classification and localization without task-specific training. Checkpoints: DGTRS-CLIP-ViT-L-14 and DGTRS-CLIP-ViT-B-16 on HuggingFace. Companion DGTRSD dataset on ModelScope: https://www.modelscope.cn/datasets/MitsuiChen14/DGTRSD.

Name: TimeSenCLIP
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.11919 (also published in ISPRS J. PERS 2026, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0924271626001577). TimeSenCLIP is a compact time-series vision-language model for remote sensing that links Sentinel-2 satellite observations with location-tagged ground-level imagery through temporal contrastive learning without text labels, examining whether pixel-level spectral and temporal signals can support diverse tasks. Weights (TimeSenCLIP_1x1.ckpt) hosted on HuggingFace (pallavijainpj/TimeSenCLIP); no public GitHub repository found.

Name: EarthGPT
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16822. Universal multimodal LLM with visual-enhanced perception, cross-modal mutual comprehension and unified instruction tuning for optical/SAR/infrared RS image comprehension. Model weights and code are not released; the official repo only shares the companion MMRS-1M dataset (1M+ image-text pairs from 34 datasets) via Baidu NetDisk (https://pan.baidu.com/s/1TOMdgiVMSvcYw-8TAp8Ryg?pwd=b2ru) and OneDrive links.
Error: Model weights and code not released; only the MMRS-1M dataset is available

Name: EarthMarker
Comments: Paper: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10817639 (arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.13596). EarthMarker is a visual-prompting multimodal large language model for remote sensing that takes boxes and points as visual cues, connects multi-scale image patterns with text, and transfers knowledge across domains; releases the RSVP dataset. Model weights not released; the official repo (wivizhang/earthmarker) currently contains only the README. RSVP dataset on Baidu NetDisk: https://pan.baidu.com/s/1_kMO5bBje7JXTNpxDiCvqg?pwd=gqdb (OneDrive version was listed as uploading).
Error: Model weights and code not yet released; GitHub repo contains only README and a figure.

Name: GeoChat
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.15826 (CVPR 2024). GeoChat is a grounded large vision-language model for remote sensing that builds a diverse instruction set for image captioning, VQA, visual grounding and region captioning, extending LLaVA to the remote sensing domain. LoRA-merged 7B checkpoint on HuggingFace (MBZUAI/geochat-7B); instruction dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/GeoChat_Instruct; project page https://mbzuai-oryx.github.io/GeoChat/.

Name: LHRS-Bot
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02544 (ECCV 2024, DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-72904-1_26). LHRS-Bot empowers remote sensing with a VGI-enhanced large multimodal language model, using volunteered geographic information to improve geospatial perception and reasoning. Repo releases code, training framework, model weights and dataset; LHRS-Bot Stage-3 checkpoint on Google Drive (link above) and Baidu NetDisk (code qhqw), Stage-1/2 checkpoints also provided in README. Improved successor LHRS-Bot-Nova hosted at https://huggingface.co/LHRS/LHRS-Bot-Nova. Note: NMGeo/LHRS-Bot no longer exists; official repo is under the NJU-LHRS organization.

Name: RingMoGPT
Comments: Paper: DOI 10.1109/TGRS.2024.3510833 (IEEE TGRS), Wang Peijin, Hu Huiyang, Tong Boyuan et al., Sun Xian corr. Unified remote sensing foundation model for vision, language and grounded tasks, using domain-adaptive adapter training on frozen vision/language backbones with location-aware querying and multi-temporal change modeling. No public GitHub repository or model weights found on GitHub, HuggingFace or ModelScope.
Error: Model weights not released; no public code repository found

Name: RSUniVLM
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05679. Unified vision-language model for remote sensing covering image-, region- and pixel-level tasks plus multi-image analysis (change detection/captioning) via a granularity-oriented mixture of experts, with a self-built instruction dataset. Checkpoints on Google Drive; online demo at https://huggingface.co/spaces/liux-cyber/RSUniVLM; project page https://rsunivlm.github.io/.

Name: SkySenseGPT
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10100. Introduces FIT-RS, a fine-grained remote sensing instruction-tuning dataset (1,800,851 samples) with FIT-RSFG/FIT-RSRC benchmarks, and SkySenseGPT built on the SkySense foundation model for RS vision-language understanding. Model weights (CLIP-aligned LoRA/adapter) released on HuggingFace as ll-13/SkySenseGPT-7B-CLIP-ViT; companion FIT-RS dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ll-13/FIT-RS.

Name: Falcon
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.11070. Holistic RS vision-language foundation model (0.7B) with a unified prompt-based paradigm supporting 14 tasks, trained on the 78M-sample Falcon_SFT collection and evaluated across 67 datasets. Checkpoints released on both HuggingFace and ModelScope (Falcon-Single-Instruction-Large, Falcon-Multi-Instruction-Large, Falcon-Single-Instruction-Base). ModelScope repos under TianHuiLab (Falcon-Single-Instruction-Base/Large) exist but contain no public files as of 2026-08.

Name: RSGPT
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.15266 (ISPRS J. PERS 2025, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0924271625001352). RSGPT is a remote sensing vision-language model for image captioning and VQA, released together with RSICap (2,585 human-annotated captions) and the RSIEval benchmark. Code only, no public weights (repo releases training/testing code). RSICap/RSIEval datasets require filling a Google Form linked in the repo. Note: the official repo is Lavender105/RSGPT as linked in the paper; the previously circulated YuanHu2001/RSGPT no longer exists.

Name: SkyEyeGPT
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09712 (ISPRS J. PERS 2025). SkyEyeGPT unifies remote sensing vision-language tasks via instruction tuning with a large language model: the authors build a manually verified 968k-sample instruction set (SkyEye-968k), align image features into the language space, and use two-step tuning for open-ended image- and region-level tasks. Weight file SkyEyeGPT.pth on HuggingFace; companion SkyEye-968k dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZhanYang-nwpu/SkyEye-968k.
Error: Batch placeholder arXiv:2401.01075 points to an unrelated paper; the correct SkyEyeGPT arXiv ID is 2401.09712.

Name: TEOChat
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06234 (ICLR 2025). First vision-language assistant for temporal Earth observation data, trained on the TEOChatlas instruction dataset for single- and multi-timestamp tasks such as change detection/captioning, damage assessment and temporal scene classification. Weights and the TEOChatlas dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/jirvin16/TEOChatlas) are on HuggingFace.

Name: Earth-OneVision
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10819. 2B-parameter RS multimodal LLM extending to optical, SAR, infrared, multispectral, temporal and video inputs across nine task areas, using feature-language alignment, spatial-output tokenization and staged cross-modality adaptation, supported by the MMRS-OneVision (~34M-instruction) QA dataset. No code or weights release found on GitHub/HuggingFace/ModelScope.
Error: Model weights not yet released

Name: SkyNative
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17949. Native multimodal RS framework that removes the pretrained visual backbone and encodes raw image patches directly into the autoregressive token sequence with modality-specific parameters; proposes RSME-Bench, which probes image reliance via visual degradation and misleading prompts. No code or weights release found on GitHub/HuggingFace/ModelScope.
Error: Model weights not yet released

Name: CastDet
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.11646 (ECCV 2024). CLIP-activated student-teacher framework for open-vocabulary aerial object detection: RemoteCLIP serves as an additional teacher with queue-based reliable pseudo-labeling, achieving e.g. 46.5% mAP on VisDroneZSD novel categories. Code only, no public weights (training relies on the chendelong/RemoteCLIP checkpoint from HuggingFace).
Error: No pretrained weights released (code only)

Name: GeoGround
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11904. GeoGround is a unified large vision-language model for remote sensing visual grounding that supports horizontal boxes, oriented boxes, and pixel masks via Text-Mask output with prompt-assisted and geometry-guided learning. LLaVA-based weights (llava-v1.5-7b-task-lora-geoground) run directly with LLaVA; companion dataset refGeo at https://huggingface.co/datasets/erenzhou/refGeo. GitHub repo (zytx121/GeoGround) now redirects to VisionXLab/GeoGround.

Name: Cross-View OVD
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03858. Cross-view open-vocabulary object detection in aerial imagery by Kini, Gupta and Shah: transfers ground-level vision-language knowledge to overhead detection by aligning visual embeddings across viewpoints and connecting overhead images with textual concepts, evaluated on multiple public benchmarks. No code or weights release found.
Error: Model weights not yet released

Name: EarthMind
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01667 (Shu Yan et al.). EarthMind is the first multi-granular, multi-sensor Earth observation LMM, handling optical (RGB/multispectral) and SAR imagery via hierarchical cross-modal attention; trained on FusionEO and evaluated on the new EarthMind-Bench (10 subtasks: classification, VQA, captioning, segmentation). Weights on HuggingFace: sy1998/EarthMind-4B (finetuned, single-sensor), sy1998/EarthMind4B_multi (multi-sensor), sy1998/EarthMind-Pretrain; training data (sy1998/EarthMind-data) and EarthMind-Bench also released. Official repo is the EOVLMs family repo (EarthMind subfolder).
Error: Batch file listed arXiv 2506.06241, but that ID resolves to an unrelated condensed-matter physics paper; the correct EarthMind arXiv ID is 2506.01667.

Name: FASE
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1145/3746252.3760838 (CIKM 2025). FASE (Feature-Aligned Scene Encoding) constructs scene representations from high-quality captions generated by a specialized VLM; its Feature Alignment Module fuses domain-specific caption embeddings with general text features via dual-branch gated fusion and cross-attention, improving open-vocabulary detection in RS imagery with no extra inference cost.
Error: No public code or model weights released as of 2026-08-24; ACM landing page returned HTTP 403.

Name: GeoMag
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.05887 / https://doi.org/10.1145/3746027.3754559 (ACM MM 2025). GeoMag (Geographical Magnifier) is an end-to-end general-purpose RS VLM that uses Task-driven Multi-granularity Resolution Adjustment and Prompt-guided Semantic-aware Cropping to enhance task-relevant regions and suppress background, improving pixel-level parsing and small-object recognition on 10 benchmarks while reducing computational cost.
Error: No public code or model weights found as of 2026-08-24 (no GitHub repo on author profiles or search).

Name: InstructSAM
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15818. InstructSAM is a training-free framework for instruction-oriented remote sensing counting, detection, and segmentation: a large vision-language model parses instructions and estimates counts, SAM2 generates mask proposals, and binary integer programming assigns labels under counting constraints, with a new benchmark. Code only, no public weights (reuses third-party Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SAM2, and RS-CLIP variants from HuggingFace). Benchmark images: DIOR (Google Drive) and NWPU-VHR-10 (OneDrive). Project page: https://voyagerxvoyagerx.github.io/InstructSAM/; repo description notes NeurIPS 2025 acceptance. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 per the official repo.

Name: LAE-DINO
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.09110 (AAAI 2025). Introduces the Locate Anything on Earth (LAE) task, builds the LAE-1M pseudo-labeled corpus via automated labeling across multiple datasets, and trains LAE-DINO with batch-adaptive vocabulary and visual-to-semantic prompt enhancement for open-vocabulary detection in Earth observation imagery (DIOR, DOTAv2.0, LAE-80C). Checkpoints (LAE-1M pretrained Swin-T plus DIOR/DOTAv2 fine-tunes) on HuggingFace and ModelScope; companion dataset LAE-1M at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ML4Sustain/LAE-1M and LAE-80C on Google Drive.

Name: LLaMA-Unidetector
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2025.3564332 (IEEE TGRS 2025). LLaMA-Unidetector is an LLaMA-based universal framework for open-vocabulary object detection in remote sensing imagery, using a two-stage locate-then-recognize design with a LLaMA-based multimodal recognizer, supported by the TerraVQA benchmark. Localization weights (checkpoint0033_4scale.pth) on Google Drive; recognition-stage 7B weights on Baidu Pan (password 1234).

Name: OpenRSD
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06146 (ICCV 2025). OpenRSD handles open/multimodal prompts for oriented and horizontal bounding-box detection in remote sensing images, balancing accuracy and speed with multi-task heads and staged training, reaching 20.8 FPS real-time inference. Weights and dataset on Baidu Pan (password aan9); a lightweight checkpoint with visual/text embeddings is at https://pan.baidu.com/s/1qJJb6NW5DW1hpXpxWOdrOg?pwd=cwy9.

Name: RemoteSAM
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18022 (ACM MM 2025 oral, DOI 10.1145/3746027.3754950). RemoteSAM uses an automated data engine to build 270K image-text-mask triplets and trains one general-purpose model for recognition, localization, mask prediction, and text grounding without task-specific heads. Weight file RemoteSAMv1.pth on HuggingFace; companion dataset RemoteSAM270k at https://huggingface.co/datasets/1e12Leon/RemoteSAM270k and https://www.modelscope.cn/datasets/e12Leon/RemoteSAM_270K. A third-party derivative (RemoteSAM++, DINOv3+ModernBERT backbone) is at modelscope.cn/models/JuneJayZ/RemoteSAM-plus-plus; it is not a mirror of the official v1 weights.

Name: RSVG-ZeroOV
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.18711. RSVG-ZeroOV is a training-free framework for zero-shot open-vocabulary visual grounding in remote sensing images: a frozen vision-language model associates query terms with image regions, a diffusion prior refines shape/structure, and a refinement step suppresses false responses. Code only, no public weights (training-free; uses third-party Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and SAM ViT-H). Repo description notes AAAI 2026 acceptance; the authors' extended v2 repo (like413/RSVG-ZeorOV-v2, arXiv 2606.16124) still has TODO placeholder weight links. Accepted at AAAI 2026 per the official repo.

Name: UniGeoSeg
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23332. UniGeoSeg provides unified instruction-guided open-world segmentation for geospatial scenes via a multi-task framework, a large generated dataset, and an evaluation benchmark, with strong generalization to unseen settings. Model weights (model.safetensors) on HuggingFace; companion dataset GeoSeg-1M on Baidu Pan (https://pan.baidu.com/s/1GldxhdvJqlsI-qyq3Uvqkw, code thxx; HuggingFace version still uploading) and GeoSeg-Bench at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nishuo1999/GeoSeg-Bench. Official repo notes CVPR 2026 acceptance. Accepted at CVPR 2026 per the official repo.

Name: GeoLLaVA-8K
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21375 (Wang Fengxiang et al.). Scales RS multimodal LLMs to 8K resolution by exploiting low semantic density of RS imagery: Background Token Pruning and Anchored Token Selection reduce token cost while preserving small-object tokens. Introduces SuperRS-VQA (~8376x8378) and HighRS-VQA (~2000x1912) UHR VQA datasets (81,367 SFT pairs, released as HuggingFace initiacms/GeoLLaVA-Data) and reports leading results on XLRS-Bench. Accepted as NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight (batch venue was 'arXiv'). Built on LongVA.

Name: Zoom-RS (Look Where It Matters)
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20460 (Zhou Yunqi et al.). ZoomSearch ('Zoom-RS') is a training-free, plug-and-play pipeline for ultra-high-resolution RS VQA that decouples 'where to look' from 'how to answer' via Adaptive Multi-Branch Zoom Search and Layout-Aware Patch Reassembly; with LLaVA-OneVision it improves 26.3% on LRS-VQA and 114.8% on MME-RealWorld-RS while 20-44% faster than prior search-based methods. Code only, no public weights (the method is training-free and uses off-the-shelf models such as lmms-lab/llava-onevision-qwen2-7b-ov and openbmb/VisRAG-Ret). Project page: https://kiki-zyq.github.io/Zoom-Search/. Evaluated on MME-RealWorld-RS and LRS-VQA.

Name: ZoomEarth
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.12267 (Liu Ruixun et al.). ZoomEarth is an active-perception VLM (built on Qwen2.5-VL-3B) for visual reasoning/QA on ultra-high-resolution RS imagery, using an adaptive cropping-zooming framework trained with SFT and GRPO RL; it integrates with downstream tasks (cloud removal, denoising, segmentation, editing). Introduces the LRS-GRO benchmark (global/region/object-level questions; HuggingFace datasets/HappyBug/LRS-GRO). Accepted as CVPR 2026 Highlight (batch venue was 'arXiv'). Project page: https://earth-insights.github.io/ZoomEarth/.

Name: Earthsynth
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12108 (Pan Jiancheng et al.). EarthSynth is a diffusion-based (ControlNet/SD-v1.5) generative foundation model synthesizing multi-category, cross-satellite labeled Earth observation data for downstream interpretation; uses Counterfactual Composition training with 3D batch-sample selection and a rule-based R-Filter, improving scene classification, object detection and semantic segmentation incl. open-vocabulary tasks. Trained on EarthSynth-180K (HuggingFace datasets/jaychempan/EarthSynth-180K), derived from OEM, LoveDA, DeepGlobe, SAMRS and LAE-1M. Model weights on HuggingFace (jaychempan/EarthSynth); training code still TODO ('coming soon'); online demo on ModelScope Studio (ML4Sustain/EarthSynth). Project page: https://jianchengpan.space/projects/EarthSynth/.

Name: Text2Earth
Comments: Paper: IEEE GRSM 2025, DOI 10.1109/MGRS.2025.3560455 (https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10988859; arXiv:2501.00895). Text2Earth is a 1.3B-parameter diffusion-based generative foundation model for text-driven, resolution-controllable (0.5-128 m) remote sensing image synthesis, editing, unbounded scene construction and cross-modal generation, trained on the Git-10M dataset (10.5M global image-text pairs; HuggingFace datasets/lcybuaa/Git-10M and ModelScope datasets/lcybuaa1111/Git-10M). Also released: Text2Earth-inpainting (HF lcybuaa/Text2Earth-inpainting; ModelScope lcybuaa1111/Text2Earth-inpainting) and the Git-RSCLIP image-text foundation model. Project page: https://chen-yang-liu.github.io/Text2Earth/.

Name: CalNet
Comments: Paper: DOI 10.1145/3581783.3612651 (He Xiao et al., 'Multispectral Object Detection via Cross-Modal Conflict-Aware Learning', ACM MM 2023 Oral, pp. 1465-1474). CALNet addresses semantic conflicts between RGB and IR modalities with a Cross-Modal Conflict Rectification (CCR) module and a Selected Cross-modal Fusion (SCF) module, built into a two-stream one-stage detector evaluated on DroneVehicle. Pre-training weights hosted on Baidu NetDisk (https://pan.baidu.com/s/1PnmdKqIxPnTgK6yQ6WfwpA, password: zvi2); reorganized DroneVehicle labels also on Baidu NetDisk (password: 5sow).

Name: S2A-Det
Comments: Paper: DOI 10.1109/TGRS.2023.3307288 (He Xiao et al., 'Object Detection in Hyperspectral Image via Unified Spectral-Spatial Feature Aggregation', IEEE TGRS 2023; also arXiv:2306.08370). S2ADet is a hyperspectral object detector with a hyperspectral information decoupling (HID) module (band selection + PCA), a two-stream spectral-spatial feature aggregation network and a one-stage detection head. Code only, no public weights: README says S2ADet pretrained weights 'Soon coming' (never released); only generic YOLOv5 pretrained backbones are linked (Google Drive). Companion dataset HOD3K (3,242 hyperspectral images, 3 classes, 16 bands) released on Baidu NetDisk.
Error: Pretrained model weights marked 'Soon coming' in README and still not released (only generic YOLOv5 weights provided).

Name: Enhance-then-Search (AugSearch)
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.04517. Enhance-Then-Search uses foundation models for cross-domain few-shot object detection: images are first enhanced to build pseudo-domain pools, then a search finds pseudo-domain configurations that adapt a pretrained detector (Grounding DINO Swin-B) to the scarce target domain; NTIRE 2025 CD-FSOD Challenge winner at CVPR 2025 Workshop. Baidu Pan link hosts model checkpoints (extraction code ttue).

Name: SDCM
Comments: Paper: DOI 10.1109/TMM.2025.3586155 (He Xiao et al., 'Spectral Discrepancy and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency Learning for Object Detection in Hyperspectral Images', IEEE TMM 2025). Hyperspectral object detection method exploiting spectral discrepancy and cross-modal semantic consistency. No official GitHub repository, model weights, or dataset release found as of 2026-08-24 (searched author hexiao0275's repos and GitHub; none match).
Error: No public code or model weights released; no official GitHub repository found.

Name: Semantic-Aware Ship Detection
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15930. Proposes a vision-language framework for ship detection in remote sensing imagery that pairs VLMs with a multi-scale adaptive sliding window strategy, and introduces ShipSem-VL for fine-grained ship attribute descriptions (IGARSS 2025). No official code or weights found.

Name: LCMA
Comments: Paper: DOI 10.3390/electronics15030498 (He Xiao et al., 'Efficient Layer-Wise Cross-View Calibration and Aggregation for Multispectral Object Detection', Electronics 15(3):498, 2026). LCMA performs layer-wise cross-modality/cross-view calibration and aggregation for RGB-infrared (RGBT) object detection, built as a two-stream rotated OBB detector (yolov5-obb based) evaluated on DroneVehicle-style benchmarks. Code only, no public weights: repo (hexiao0275/LCMA_RGBT) contains training/eval code only, with no pretrained weight links in README. Note: README title ('Cross-Modality ... RGB-Infrared') differs slightly from the published title ('Cross-View ... Multispectral').

Name: Rethinking Transformers (RS Segmentation)
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2023.3302024. Proposes GLOTS, which rethinks Transformers for remote sensing semantic segmentation using transformer encoding/decoding, multiscale feature fusion, broad- and fine-scale attention, and gradual upsampling for detail recovery. The Google Drive link hosts pretrained backbone weights (placed in the repo's pretrain/ folder); the repo is built on MMSegmentation with BEiT-2/Swin configs.

Name: Multilevel Multimodal Fusion Transformer
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2024.3373033. Proposes FTransUNet, a multilevel multimodal fusion Transformer combining CNN shallow-feature fusion with a Transformer deep-feature fusion stage for remote sensing semantic segmentation. Code only, no public weights (README points to the Google Cloud Storage vit_models bucket for ImageNet-21k ViT backbone pretraining).

Name: Diverse Instance Generation (Diffusion)
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18031. Proposes a diffusion-based augmentation method for few-shot object detection in remote sensing images that synthesizes diverse object instances: instance-level slices are created and inserted into full images, with a class-agnostic inversion module and contrastive learning for semantic alignment. No official code or weights found.

Name: SAN (Scene-aware Aggregation)
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1145/3591106.3592236. Proposes SWAN, a Scene-aware Aggregation Network that reduces semantic confusion in remote sensing cross-modal (image-text) retrieval via scene-aware aggregation (ICMR 2023 oral). The Baidu link hosts ResNet50 backbone weights pretrained on AID; no full SWAN checkpoint is released.

Name: DOVE (Direction-Oriented Embedding)
Comments: Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/TGRS.2024.3392779 (arXiv:2310.08276). Proposes DOVE, a direction-oriented visual-semantic embedding model for remote sensing image-text retrieval that addresses visual-semantic imbalance via ROAM alignment of image/text embeddings, DTGA for broadening text representation, and a global constraint reducing single-view dependence; evaluated on RSICD and RSITMD. No code or weights released.

Name: PiR (Prior Instruction Representation)
Comments: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.10160. Proposes PIR/PriorCLIP, a visual-prior-guided vision-language model for remote sensing image-text retrieval that uses prior instruction representation with progressive attention encoders (Spatial/Temporal-PAE) and a two-stage prior representation learning strategy to reduce semantic noise and domain shift; evaluated on RSICD and RSITMD. Baidu link hosts model weights (extraction code 2v3v).
